Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Oh, hello...
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Och, ahoj...

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Sorry, I can't right now.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Promiň, teď nemůžu.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: *yawnnnnn*
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: *zívvvvv*

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: You know the problem with a nap? You always feel MORE tired after!
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Znáš ten problém se šlofíkem? Člověk se po něm cítí ještě VÍC unavený!

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Hey. Wait just a minute here! Who are you?
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Hele. Momentíček! Kdo jsi?

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: {PlayerName}.
The Ruler of Dreamlight Valley? Duh.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Vládce Dreamlight Valley? No přece.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Who am I? Who are YOU, big talking magical mermaid statue?
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Kdo jsem já? Kdo jsi TY, ty velká mluvící kouzelná socho mořské panny?

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: {PlayerName}... Okay, I've DEFINITELY heard that name before.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: {PlayerName}... Dobrá, tohle jméno už jsem ROZHODNĚ někdy slyšela.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: You look almost like...
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Vypadáš skoro jako...

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: But no. You're too old.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Ale ne. Jsi na to moc starý.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Way too old to be the Legendary Adventurer.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Až moc na to, abys byl ten Legendární dobrodruh.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: I'm older now, but I was younger once.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Teď jsem starší, ale kdysi jsem byl mladší.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Just who is this Legendary Adventurer?
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Kdo je vlastně ten Legendární dobrodruh?

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Hey! Who are you calling old?
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Hej! Koho to tady nazýváš starým?

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Wait. You're right! That's TOTALLY how linear time works! You could be the Legendary Adventurer... just older!
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Počkej. Máš pravdu! Přesně TAKHLE lineární čas funguje! Mohl bys být ten Legendární dobrodruh... jenom starší!

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: I've been waiting for the Legendary Adventurer to come back and wake me up for... well, I don't know how long, since I was asleep the whole time and it felt like a blink for me.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Čekala jsem, až se Legendární dobrodruh vrátí a probudí mě... no, ani nevím jak dlouho, protože jsem celou dobu spala a mně to přišlo jen jako mrknutí oka.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Let me tell you a little story.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Povím ti takový krátký příběh.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Soooo. If you really are the Legendary Adventurer...
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Takžeee. Jestli jsi vážně ten Legendární dobrodruh...

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: ...you're gonna have to <Lore>prove yourself</Lore>.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: ...budeš se muset <Lore>osvědčit</Lore>.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: I've got a little challenge for you. A set of riddles that will show me whether you've really got the spirit of discovery.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Mám pro tebe takovou malou výzvu. Sérii hádanek, které mi ukážou, jestli v sobě vážně máš objevitelského ducha.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Prove yourself to me, and I'll tell you how to get to the kingdom.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Dokaž mi, co v tobě je, a já ti řeknu, jak se dostat do království.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Good luck! You got this!
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Hodně štěstí! To zvládneš!

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: You know. The one who does all sorts of legendary adventure-y stuff.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Však víš. Ten, co dělá všechny ty legendární dobrodružné věci.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: I didn't say OLD. I said OLDER. As in, OLDER than the Legendary Adventurer. Which you DEFINITELY are.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Neřekla jsem STARÝ. Řekla jsem STARŠÍ. Jakože STARŠÍ než ten Legendární dobrodruh. Což ROZHODNĚ jsi.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Dreamlight Valley? Okay, that's ringing a bell.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Dreamlight Valley? Dobrá, to mi něco říká.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Don't worry. We'll get to that. Eventually.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Neboj. K tomu se dostaneme. Časem.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Huh. You... you completed my riddles...?
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: No teda. Ty... ty jsi ty moje hádanky opravdu vyluštil/a...?

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Gotta admit, {PlayerName}... I'm impressed!
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Musím uznat, {PlayerName}... udělal/a jsi na mě dojem!

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: I feel the magic being restored to me. Heh-heh! You really do have the spirit of discovery.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Cítím, jak se mi vrací magie. Hehe! V tobě se ten objevitelský duch vážně nezapře.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Your challenge was actually... pretty fun!
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Tvoje výzva byla vlastně... docela zábavná!

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: It was tough, but I managed it.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Bylo to těžké, ale zvládl/a jsem to.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Please tell me you don't have more CHORES for me.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Prosím tě, řekni mi, že pro mě nemáš další POVINNOSTI.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: I see that old sparkle coming back to your eyes. You're <Lore>just the way I remembered you</Lore>.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Vidím, jak se ti do očí vrací ta stará jiskra. Jsi <Lore>přesně takový/á, jak si tě pamatuju</Lore>.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Finally, there was my youngest sister, <Lore>Boldness</Lore>.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: A nakonec tu byla moje nejmladší sestra, <Lore>Odvážnost</Lore>.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Who stood for the spirit that never asks itself "why not?"
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Která ztělesňovala ducha, co se nikdy neptá „proč ne?“

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: To <Lore>reach the kingdom</Lore>... you must <Lore>awaken my sisters</Lore>.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Abys <Lore>dosáhl/a království</Lore>... musíš <Lore>probudit mé sestry</Lore>.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: I'll do whatever I have to.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Udělám cokoli, co bude potřeba.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: How exactly do I do that?
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Jak přesně to mám udělat?

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Got it. Craft one giant alarm clock.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Chápu. Vyrobit jeden obří budík.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: You are the Legendary Adventurer. I'm sure of it now. You've just forgotten.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Ty jsi ten legendární dobrodruh. Teď už jsem si jistá. Jen jsi na to zapomněl/a.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: With a touch of Dreamlight Magic, the Adventurer created me and my sisters to watch over this place and keep it safe.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: S dotekem magie Dreamlight nás Dobrodruh stvořil – mě i mé sestry – abychom na toto místo dohlížely a chránily ho.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: First came little old me, <Lore>Discovery</Lore>, the spirit that sent our Adventurer out into these uncharted waters.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Jako první jsem přišla na řadu já, <Lore>Objevitelka</Lore>, duch, který vyslal našeho Dobrodruha do těchto neprobádaných vod.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Next came my sister at the lighthouse in the grotto beyond Shipwreck Shores.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Pak přišla moje sestra u majáku v jeskyni za Pobřežím vraků.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Her magic was <Lore>Resilience</Lore>, the very same strength that helped our Adventurer rise above skinned knees and hurt feelings.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Její magií byla <Lore>Houževnatost</Lore>, přesně ta síla, která našemu Dobrodruhovi pomáhala překonat odřená kolena i pošramocené city.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Next, in the waters beyond <Lore>Candy Cove</Lore>, was my sister <Lore>Expression</Lore>...
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Další, ve vodách za <Lore>Cukrátkovou zátokou</Lore>, byla moje sestra <Lore>Sebevyjádření</Lore>...

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: ...who represented the bravery of adventurers to be utterly themselves.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: ...která představovala odvahu dobrodruhů být naprosto sami sebou.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Love that!
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: To se mi líbí!

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Oh. Oh! This is fascinating.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Ó. Ó! To je fascinující.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Here. You take a look and meet me over by the gate when you're ready. Pretty sure I know EXACTLY what we need to do next.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Tady. Podívej se na to a až budeš ready, sejdi se se mnou u brány. Jsem si skoro jistá, že vím PŘESNĚ, co musíme udělat dál.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: You already know how to do it.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Ty už víš, jak na to.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: After all, you managed to awaken me, didn't you?
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Koneckonců, mě se ti probudit podařilo, ne?

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Find the <Lore>Sunken Echoes</Lore> beneath the waves. Each one holds the memory of something you've lost.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Najdi pod vlnami <Lore>Potopené ozvěny</Lore>. Každá z nich v sobě nese vzpomínku na něco, co jsi ztratil/a.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Bring the <Lore>Keepsakes</Lore> you find there to my sisters. The ones in the glowing bottles.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Přines ty <Lore>Upomínky</Lore>, co tam najdeš, mým sestrám. Jsou v těch zářících lahvích.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Then prove yourself to them. Easy-peasy!
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Pak se jim prokaž. Brkačka!

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: I even have a <Lore>map</Lore> to help you do it.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Mám dokonce i <Lore>mapu</Lore>, která ti s tím pomůže.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Wait, did you say "map"? May I see that?
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Počkat, řekl/a jsi „mapu“? Můžu ji vidět?

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: *sigh* If only it were that simple. But don't worry.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: *povzdech* Kéž by to bylo tak jednoduché. Ale neboj se.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: That's that can-do spirit that I remember.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: To je přesně ten odhodlaný duch, kterého si pamatuju.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: Chores, tasks, questions, riddles... tomatoes, tomahtoes.
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Povinnosti, úkoly, otázky, hádanky... prašť jako uhoď.

Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.en: You've changed so much, {PlayerName}. <Lore>I barely recognize you.</Lore>
Expansion04Main_Guardian_Discovery/Guard.cz: Tak moc jsi se změnil/a, {PlayerName}. <Lore>Sotva tě poznávám.</Lore>
